fact: 1915年3月18日上午，英法联合舰队以18艘战列舰为主力强攻达达尼尔海峡最窄处（宽约1.6公里）。法舰布韦号（Bouvet）触雷后两分钟内倾覆，全舰718人仅75人生还；英舰不可抗号（Irresistible）与海洋号（Ocean）相继触雷沉没，战列巡洋舰不屈号（Inflexible）重创退出，法舰高卢号（Gaulois）搁浅。当日损失迫使舰队司令德罗贝克发出总撤退信号，纯海军强攻方案就此终止，转为陆上登陆。

sources.title: Naval Historical Society of Australia, Sweeping the Dardanelles – Naval actions prior to the Anzac landing at Gallipoli
sources.quote: At 1354 Bouvet was following Suffren out of the Straits when she hit one of the remaining 16 of Nusrat's mines. She sank within a few minutes, losing 635 men out of her complement of 670. ... Only three minutes later Irresistible struck a mine, to be followed by Ocean hitting a mine at 1805. Both battleships sank during the night. Nousret's 20 mines resulted in the sinking of three battleships and the beaching of another two.

sources.title: Anadolu Agency, March 18: Victory that changed a nation's fate
sources.quote: The attack opened on March 18, 1915, with six British and four French battleships heading towards the Narrows. Several Turkish forts near the entrance to the strait were heavily bombarded and destroyed, but the waters were filled with a network of mines, which sank the HMS Irresistible, HMS Ocean and the French battleship Bouvet.

fact: 1915年4月25日清晨，协约国在加里波利半岛多点登陆：约1.6万名澳新军团士兵在阿里布尔努（此后称澳新湾）登陆；英军与印度部队在半岛南端的赫勒斯角登陆；法军先在亚洲岸的库姆卡莱作佯攻，随后并入赫勒斯角主力。登陆部队未能夺取当日目标，战事转为堑壕对峙。

sources.title: Australian Government Department of Veterans' Affairs, Overview of Australia's involvement in the First World War
sources.quote: On 25 April 1915, some 16,000 Australians and New Zealanders landed on the Gallipoli Peninsula, 300km south-west of Constantinople (modern-day Istanbul) at Ari Burnu in an area now known as Anzac Cove. The Gallipoli campaign also involved British and Indian troops who landed at the southern tip of the peninsula at Cape Helles, and French forces landed in a feint near Kum Kale on the Dardanelles opposite shore before joining the main forces at Cape Helles.

sources.title: Anzac Portal (DVA), Gallipoli Campaign 1915
sources.quote: Early on the morning of 25 April 1915, Allied forces landed on the Gallipoli peninsula in Ottoman Türkiye. This was the start of the Gallipoli Campaign. ... Over 8 months, the Anzacs gained little more than the positions they had taken on that first day of the landings.

fact: 1915年8月协约国发动八月攻势：8月6日至15日在苏弗拉湾新登陆，8月6日至21日进行萨里巴伊尔（八月攻势）作战，8月6日至10日进行孤松战斗，8月7日发生内克冲锋。攻势未能打开通往海峡的道路，双方在半岛的僵局延续到秋季。

sources.title: Anzac Portal (DVA), Gallipoli Campaign 1915
sources.quote: Main battles involving Australians: Landing at Anzac Cove 25 April 1915 Early battles and the Third Turkish Attack on Anzac Cove 19 May 1915 Landing at Suvla Bay 6 to 15 August 1915 Battle of Sari Bair (August Offensive) 6 to 21 August 1915 Battle of Lone Pine 6 to 10 August 1915 Charge at the Nek 7 August 1915

fact: 加里波利撤退分两阶段完成：澳新军团与苏弗拉湾部队在1915年12月19日至20日撤离，赫勒斯角与其余协约国部队在1916年1月8日至9日撤离。撤退以伪装维持空壕假象，伤亡极小，被协约国方面视为战役中唯一成功的行动。

sources.title: Australian Government Department of Veterans' Affairs, Overview of Australia's involvement in the First World War
sources.quote: The evacuation, which was completed over 19–20 December 1915, was considered a success, with very few men becoming casualties.

sources.title: Anzac Portal (DVA), Gallipoli Campaign 1915
sources.quote: By November 1915, it was clear that the stalemate was not likely to end. British Chief of Staff Lord Kitchener recommended an evacuation. In late December, the Anzacs evacuated from the peninsula with very few casualties. By 20 January 1916, all Allied personnel had withdrawn.

fact: 加里波利战役的伤亡统计因口径不同而差异很大。澳大利亚官方战史门户并列五家来源的估计：奥斯曼一方投入约50万人，阵亡或死于伤病6.6万至8.6692万人，非致命伤患21.3308万人；英国与英属印度投入34.8万人，死亡2.2613万至2.7736万人；法国及其殖民地部队投入7.9万人，死亡8000至1万人；澳新军团死亡约1万余人。该表明确说明「多数统计尤其土耳其方面仅为估计」。

sources.title: Anzac Portal (DVA), Gallipoli Campaign 1915（Table 1: Approximate casualties for forces in the Gallipoli Campaign, 1915）
sources.quote: Sources differ in their definition of a casualty of the Gallipoli Campaign. This leads to the publication of many different statistics. ... Ottoman Empire (now Türkiye) 500,000 66,000–86,692 213,308 ... United Kingdom and British India 348,000 22,613–27,736 48,517 ... France and French colonial 79,000 8,000–10,000 15,000–17,000 ... Most casualty statistics, particularly Turkish, are estimates only.

fact: 1915年4月24日夜，奥斯曼内政部下令在首都抓捕亚美尼亚社区领袖。第一波被捕者数目各来源不一，为200至270名（通行区间235至270名）知识分子、教士、医生、编辑、记者、律师与教师，行动于当晚8时开始，由君士坦丁堡警察局长贝德里主持；第二波使被捕人数升至500至600人。据估计累计有2345名亚美尼亚知名人士被拘押并最终遣送，其中多数人与任何政党并无组织关系。此日后来被定为亚美尼亚种族灭绝纪念日。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Deportation of Armenian notables in 1915
sources.quote: On the night of 24–25 April 1915, in a first wave 235 to 270 Armenian leaders of Constantinople, clergymen, physicians, editors, journalists, lawyers, teachers, politicians, and others were arrested upon an instruction of the Ministry of the Interior. ... A second wave brought the figure to between 500 and 600. ... In total, it is estimated that 2,345 Armenian notables were detained and eventually deported, most of whom were not nationalists and did not have any political affiliations.

sources.title: Lumen Learning, The Armenian Genocide（SUNY World History）
sources.quote: The order to do so was given by Minister of the Interior Talaat Pasha on April 24, 1915. On that night, the first wave of 235 to 270 Armenian intellectuals of Constantinople were arrested. Eventually, arrests and deportations totaled 2,345.

sources.title: U.S. National Archives (Reagan Library), Armenian Assembly of America issue brief（1990年代档案汇编）
sources.quote: On April 24, 1915, 200 Armenian religious, political, and intellectual leaders were arrested in Constantinople (Istanbul), exiled, or taken to the interior and murdered.

fact: 关于1915至1916年奥斯曼亚美尼亚人死亡人数，不同来源的估计区间不一致，本条目并列而不取单一数字：一种表述为「80万至150万以上」，另一种表述为「80万至180万以上」，通行的概数为约150万；土耳其共和国政府长期否认「种族灭绝」这一定性，主张死亡人数远低于上述数字且系战争与迁移所致。学界对事件性质的主流表述与土耳其官方立场存在根本分歧，双方各自援引档案，本资料包不对人数作定论。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Temporary Law of Deportation
sources.quote: The resettlement campaign resulted in the deaths of anywhere between 800,000 and over 1,500,000 civilians, in what historians widely characterize as the Armenian genocide.

sources.title: Lumen Learning, The Armenian Genocide（SUNY World History）
sources.quote: The resettlement campaign resulted in the deaths of anywhere between 800,000 and more than 1.8 million civilians ... Governments of Republic of Turkey have since consistently rejected charges of genocide, typically arguing either that those Armenians who died were simply in the way of a war or that killing Armenians was justified by their individual or collective support for the enemies of the Ottoman Empire.

fact: 奥斯曼内阁于1915年5月27日通过《临时迁移法》（Tehcir Kanunu，正式名称为《战时对违反政府措施者由军方采取之措施临时法》），授权军方对被视为危害国家安全者实施迁移；该法于1915年6月1日正式生效，1916年2月8日期满。1915年9月13日议会又通过《临时征收与没收法》，规定亚美尼亚人的土地、牲畜与房屋由当局没收。1918年12月18日奥斯曼众议院宣布上述两项法律无效。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Temporary Law of Deportation
sources.quote: was a law passed by the Ottoman Council of Ministers on May 27, 1915 authorizing the deportation of the Ottoman Empire's Armenian population. ... The bill was officially enacted on June 1, 1915, and expired on February 8, 1916. On 18 December 1918, the Ottoman Chamber of Deputies declared the Tehcir Law and the temporary law which authorized selling of confiscated Armenian property rescinded and illegal. ... On September 13, 1915, the Ottoman parliament passed the "Temporary Law of Expropriation and Confiscation," stating that all property, including land, livestock, and homes belonging to Armenians, was to be confiscated by Ottoman authorities.

sources.title: Pressbooks (CCCO), The Ottoman Empire
sources.quote: On May 29, 1915, the CUP Central Committee passed the Temporary Law of Deportation ("Tehcir Law"), giving the Ottoman government and military authorization to deport anyone it "sensed" as a threat to national security.

fact: 1915年1月，统一与进步委员会要员卡拉·凯末尔出任伊斯坦布尔商会（Esnaf Cemiyeti）领导人，掌管首都粮食供应，拥有征用磨坊与面包房的无限权力；面包配给票由此推行。1915年秋，大城市的粮食供应组织权从市政府移交给陆军部，政府拨款买断面粉存货，并以低于成本的价格出售配给面包以维持秩序。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War, Feeding the Population
sources.quote: In January 1915, Kemal Bey (aka Kara Kemal), a notable figure within the ruling Committee of Union and Progress, assumed leadership of the Tradesmen's Union (Esnaf Cemiyeti), tasked with overseeing food provision. Kemal Bey wielded unrestricted authority over all food-related matters, including the power to requisition mills and bakeries for the collective good.

sources.title: Harry Stuermer, Two War Years in Constantinople, ch. V（1917 年英文版，ArmenianHouse 全文）
sources.quote: At a comparatively early stage they followed Germany's example and introduced bread tickets, which were quite successful so long as the flour lasted. In the autumn of 1915 they took the organisation of the bread supply for large towns out of the hands of the municipalities, and gave it over to the War Office. They got Parliament to vote a large fund to buy up all available supplies of flour ... they decided to sell it at a very considerable loss to themselves, so that the price of the daily ration (though not of the supplementary ration) remained very much as it had been in peace time.

fact: 战时伊斯坦布尔的粮食运输与供应许可被政府集中分配：为把有限的铁路与黑海船运优先用于首都，政府自行指定少数商人承担供应，许可证只发给与统一与进步委员会有关的穆斯林—土耳其裔商人。同一时期，非穆斯林商行在征用、许可与合同环节处于不利地位。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War, Feeding the Population
sources.quote: This intervention fostered nepotism, affording the Committee of Union and Progress government the discretion to selectively designate a minor cohort of merchants for the privilege of supplying Istanbul. Permits were exclusively granted to Muslim-Turkish entrepreneurs affiliated with the party, aligning seamlessly with the Turkish economic nationalism espoused by the wartime government.

fact: 1915年7月，奥斯曼公债管理处（OPDA）受命发行战时第一系列纸币（evrak-ı nakdiyye），发行额658.3094万里拉，以德国提供的约1.5亿法郎黄金作准备，纸币最初与金币平价流通。此后纸币发行持续扩张，对黄金的比价逐步下跌：1916年初1金里拉兑120皮阿斯特纸币，1917年中兑400，战争结束时兑500。

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, War Finance (Ottoman Empire)
sources.quote: In 1915, the OPDA took over the responsibility to issue Ottoman paper money—an act that had since 1863 been contracted to the IOB. ... The loan agreements were ensued by the first emission of paper money by the OPDA which transpired in July 1915 (birinci tertip evrak-i nakdiyye). ... The first wartime emission amounted to 6,583,094 liras and would be reimbursed entirely in gold by the OPDA six months after the conclusion of the peace. It was covered by German gold worth around 150 million francs in the treasuries of the OPDA in Berlin and Vienna. The circulation value of the paper notes equaled the gold lira.

sources.title: Şevket Pamuk, The Ottoman Economy in World War I（Boğaziçi University 工作论文，表 4.4 及正文）
sources.quote: They started exchanging at par against the silver and gold coins in circulation in 1915. As the volume of paper bills began to expand and their denominations began to get smaller, however, their exchange rates against gold-backed currency began to decline ... The exchange rates of the kaime in Istanbul rose from 120 piasters per gold lira early in 1916 to 400 in mid-1917 and 500 at the end of the war.

fact: 1915年9月9日，德国方面通知奥斯曼驻柏林大使哈基·贝，将在年底前提供1.2亿马克的新黄金贷款；奥斯曼随后又以加里波利战役为由追加4000万马克。1915年11月9日双方换文，德国向奥斯曼公债管理处提供总额1.6亿马克的国库券，作为1915年10月31日法令批准的第二系列纸币（600万里拉）的准备金。第二系列不再以黄金而以国库券为担保，公众信心下降，金里拉与纸币里拉的差价旋即扩大。

sources.title: Turkey in the First World War, Financing the War
sources.quote: On 9 September 1915, Helfferich communicated to the Ottoman Ambassador in Berlin, Hakkı Bey, that a new gold loan amounting to 120 million Marks would be made available by year-end. Subsequently, in response to the Ottoman government's disclosure that an additional 40 million Marks were requisite for financing the ongoing Gallipoli campaign, this request was also acceded to ... An accord, endorsed by German State Secretary of the Foreign Office Gottlieb von Jagow and Ambassador Hakkı Bey on 9 November 1915, affirmed Germany's commitment to furnish treasury bonds totalling 160 million Marks to the Ottoman Public Debt Administration, serving as collateral for the envisaged banknotes. These banknotes, constituting the Second Series, were authorised through a decree promulgated on 31 October 1915, with an aggregate value of 6 million Liras.

sources.title: 1914-1918-online. International Encyclopedia of the First World War, War Finance (Ottoman Empire)
sources.quote: The agreement of 31 October 1915 was different with respect to the fact that the emission would be covered by 7,902,000 liras worth German Treasury Bonds, instead of gold.

fact: 伊斯坦布尔零售价（年均价，库鲁什/奥卡）：1915年面包自由市场1.65、羊肉8.5、面粉2.3、橄榄油14.5、盐1.5；1914年分别为面包1.25、羊肉7.0、面粉1.75、橄榄油8.0、盐1.5。同一价格表显示此后急剧上升：面包自由市场价1916年9.5、1917年18、1918年34，同期面包配给价1916年起为1.6、1917年2.5、1918年2.5；面粉1916年12、1918年45。

fact: 以1914年为100，伊斯坦布尔消费者物价指数1915年约为130，1916年212，1917年1465，1918年2205。奥斯曼公债管理处编制的该指数显示，从1914年7月到1918年底首都生活费上涨二十倍以上；同期工资与薪金的实际购买力平均下降至少80%。

sources.title: Şevket Pamuk, The Ottoman Economy in World War I（Boğaziçi University 工作论文，正文与表 4.4）
sources.quote: The cost of living index prepared by the Ottoman Public Debt Administration for Istanbul increased more than twenty-fold from July 1914 to the end of 1918 ... While consumer prices in the capital city increased more than twenty-fold until the end of the war, increases in wages and salaries lagged far behind. ... it is clear that real wages and salaries declined, on the average, by at least 80 per cent

sources.title: Büyük İstanbul Tarihi, Trade in Ottoman Istanbul（表3及战时经济段）
sources.quote: In this period of war economy, by keeping bread and mutton prices under control through state intervention (prices subject to distribution), price increases for these two items were significantly restricted (Table 3).

fact: 1915年3月7日夜至8日，奥斯曼布雷舰努斯雷特号（Nusret）在埃伦柯伊湾沿亚洲岸平行布设水雷，未被执行扫雷任务的协约国舰队察觉。协约国扫雷队按垂直于海岸的雷线作业，因此这批与岸线平行的水雷未被清扫。3月18日，法舰布韦号、英舰不可抗号与海洋号即因这批水雷沉没。不同来源对布雷数目的记载为20枚与26枚两种，均指向同一批平行雷线。

sources.title: Naval Historical Society of Australia, Sweeping the Dardanelles
sources.quote: Unbeknown, during the night of 7/8 March, a new string of mines was secretly laid parallel to the shore by Eren Keui Bay by a Turkish minelayer named Nusret. This was chosen wisely, as it was here that the battleships were manoeuvring. This one single action would become the turning point of the whole naval campaign.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Gulf of Erenköy
sources.quote: During the initial naval operations carried on by the Allies of World War I in 1914 November and 1915 February, Ottoman defenders observed that the Allied ships used the gulf of Erenköy as a maneuvering space. ... Additionally, 26 mines were laid in the Gulf of Erenköy parallel to the coast line unobserved by the Allies.

fact: 加里波利战役中因病减员超过战伤：英国官方战史记载，英帝国部队共有14.5154万人患病（不含自治领与印度部队），其中3778人死亡；约9万人因病后送，最大病因为痢疾（2.9728万人）与腹泻（1.0383万人）。奥斯曼方面因病后送6.444万人。有研究称前线部队痢疾感染率超过八成。因病后送的死亡率约2.84%，高于西线的0.91%。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Gallipoli campaign（Sickness 节，引 Aspinall-Oglander 官方战史）
sources.quote: Many soldiers became sick due to insanitary conditions, especially from typhoid, dysentery and diarrhoea. Cecil Aspinall-Oglander, the British official historian, reported that 90,000 British Empire soldiers were evacuated for illness during the campaign. A total of 145,154 British troops fell sick, not counting Dominion or Indian troops; of these, 3,778 died, exclusive of those evacuated. ... Approximately 2.84 percent of men removed as non-battle casualties died, against 0.91 percent in France and Flanders. ... Aspinall-Oglander gave the number of Ottoman troops evacuated sick as 64,440. The largest cause of non-battle admissions to hospital for British troops was dysentery, with 29,728 men infected and another 10,383 men having diarrhoea.

sources.title: National Institute for Defense Studies (Japan), The Unexpected British Medical Emergency in the Gallipoli Campaign 1915-1916
sources.quote: Dysentery was an extremely severe problem, with over eighty percent of troops infected by the disease, including the British Army General Officer Commanding at Gallipoli, General Sir Ian Hamilton, who took ten years to fully recover from it. Enteric fever (or typhoid), was common and vaccinations were not always effective: one out of three patients infected died.
